business_summary.text: India's largest private shipyard at Pipavav, Gujarat, building commercial and defence vessels with a ~₹6,500 Cr firm order book.

call_points.text: Firm order book of ~₹6,500 Cr, inclusive of government subsidy, at USDINR 95.15.
₹1,150 Cr NaBFID term loan at 8.85%, cut to 5.85% effective by 3% interest subvention.
Resolution plan closed and CoC obligations prepaid, clearing the company out of CIRP.
CEO expects domestic shipbuilding demand to pick up only over the next 12 to 18 months.

Firm order book ~₹6,500 Cr includes government subsidy, converted at USDINR 95.15.

timeline.summary: 2026-04-23: Swan Defence dispatched notice of an NCLT-convened equity shareholder meeting on May 25, 2026 to approve the amalgamation of wholly owned parent-arm Triumph Offshore into SDHIL via redeemable preference shares.
Shareholders approved Mr. Jayaramakrishnan Kannan (DIN: 06551104) as Non-Executive Independent Director via remote e-voting on 19th May 2026 with 99.9967% votes in favor.
Equity shareholders approved the scheme of amalgamation with Triumph Offshore Private Limited in an NCLT-convened meeting on May 25, 2026.
15-Oct-2026: Corporate presentation puts firm order book at ~₹6,500 Cr with H1FY27 PAT of ₹524.78 Cr on a tax credit.

status_history.evidence: Equity shareholders approved the Scheme of Arrangement and Amalgamation at the meeting held on May 25, 2026.
